sponsored.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Olean assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Olean Community Theatre, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Olean Community Theatre, Inc. for all of the 2021-2022 school taxes and all of the 2022 general taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Olean assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from OWH Properties, Inc. (Operation Warm Hearts)
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Oleans assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from OWH Properties, Inc. (Operation Warm Hearts) for all of the 2025-2026 school taxes and all of the 2025 general taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be eligible for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of West Almond, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town justice of the town of West Almond, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town, so long as such person resides in Allegany county.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting the appointment of school resource officers to private elementary and secondary schools
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the sheriff of certain counties to appoint school resource officers to private elementary and secondary schools upon the request of such private school and the approval of the county legislative body.

sponsored.t: Requires equal distribution of legislative staff and resources
sponsored.sum: Requires an equal distribution of legislative staff and appropriations to be made among all members of the legislature; provides for additional funds and staff for members in special capacities as long as such additional staff does not deal with constituent services.

sponsored.t: Ensures fairness in organ donations to persons with physical or mental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Prevents discrimination against persons with physical or mental disabilities in regards to organ donations.

sponsored.t: Ensures repeat offenders qualify for bail and pre-trial detention when the principal has been convicted of one or more misdemeanor or felony offenses
sponsored.sum: Ensures repeat offenders qualify for bail and pre-trial detention when the principal has been convicted of one or more misdemeanor or felony offenses within the immediate preceding five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effect of mandates on school districts
sponsored.sum: Provides that state mandates shall not be implemented in school districts after such district has passed a budget; provides that any such mandates shall be implemented in the following fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of Ashford, in the county of Cattaraugus, for state land therein
sponsored.sum: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of Ashford, in the county of Cattaraugus, for state lands in such town.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as parklands and lease certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as parklands and lease certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg.

sponsored.t: Prohibits unfunded mandates in medicaid
sponsored.sum: Prohibits unfunded mandates in medicaid; provides that a provision of law which is determined to be an unfunded mandate according to this new section of law shall cease to be mandatory and become voluntary in operation; defines "law" as a statute, executive order of the governor, or rule or regulation; provides such prohibition does not apply to laws in full force and effect prior to the effective date of the section.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the maximum age for taking the civil service examination for appointment as a police officer or as an environmental conservation officer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the maximum age for taking the civil service examination for appointment as a police officer or as an environmental conservation officer.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain real property conveyances from the written notice requirement
sponsored.sum: Excludes real property conveyances from the written notice requirement when such property is being conveyed by the state of New York or any of its political subdivisions as part of a foreclosure proceeding.

sponsored.t: Establishes business franchise and personal income tax credits for capital investments made in certain small businesses
sponsored.sum: Establishes business franchise and personal income tax credits for capital investments made in certain small businesses.

sponsored.t: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of New Hudson and special districts therein for state land operated by the department of environmental conservation
sponsored.sum: Provides for the payment of state aid to the town of New Hudson and special districts therein for state land operated by the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Provides for free hunting, fishing and trapping licenses to residents of the state who are active duty members of the U.S. armed forces regardless of duty station
sponsored.sum: Provides for free hunting, fishing and trapping licenses to residents of the state who are active duty members of the U.S. armed forces regardless of where such person is stationed.

sponsored.t: Requires municipalities which receive 4 or more emergency medical calls in 30 day period for an individual to report such calls to the local social services district
sponsored.sum: Requires any municipality which receives and responds to 4 or more calls for emergency medical service for an individual to report the circumstances of such calls to the local social services district and the office of the medicaid inspector general.

sponsored.t: Relates to noncompliance of an employer or income payor with income execution orders
sponsored.sum: Relates to noncompliance of an employer or income payor with income execution orders; allows child support unit to count each failure to remit payment as an instance of noncompliance.

sponsored.t: Relates to issuing temporary spousal support
sponsored.sum: Allows family court to issue temporary spousal support when issuing either a temporary order of protection or a temporary order for child support.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of aggravated harassment in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of aggravated harassment in the second degree to include the disclosure of certain private information identifying a police officer for no legitimate purpose.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement by Medicaid for services required by state law
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for Medicaid for services required by state law; provides department of health must pay 100% of the non-federal share for services required by state law, not federal.

sponsored.t: Relates to enhanced penalties for domestic violence crimes
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commission of certain specified crimes which are committed against a member of the same family or household shall be punishable as domestic violence crimes and carry enhanced penalties.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of free hunting, fishing and trapping licenses to members of the Seneca nation who reside in the state
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of free hunting, fishing and trapping licenses to members of the Seneca nation who reside in the state.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of mental health to conduct a study on utilizing the therapeutic techniques studied by the research and recognition project for the treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of mental health to conduct a study on utilizing the therapeutic techniques studied by the research and recognition project for the treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance coverage for substance use disorder treatment services
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance coverage for substance use disorder treatment services.

sponsored.t: Establishes the department of oversight and investigation; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the department of oversight and investigation, providing for its powers, duties and functions (Part A); relates to repealing provisions relating to the commission on ethics and lobbying in government; relates to repealing provisions relating to the office of the state inspector general (Part B); provides for the transfer of the functions, powers and duties of the commission on ethics and lobbying in government, the office of the state inspector general and the former temporary state commission of investigation to the department of oversight and investigation (Part C); relates to the commission on ethics and lobbying; relates to membership on the franchise oversight board…

sponsored.t: Relates to admissible evidence in court proceedings to secure an order of protection
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that in child protective proceedings and permanency hearings for children placed out of their homes, the social worker-client privilege shall not be a ground for excluding evidence in a hearing to secure an order of protection.

sponsored.t: Grants a $100,000 real property tax exemption to conservation clubs and rod and gun clubs owning certain land having an assessed value of $500,000 or less
sponsored.sum: Grants a $100,000 real property tax exemption to conservation clubs and rod and gun clubs owning land acquired prior to January 1, 2025, having an assessed value of $500,000 or less.

sponsored.t: Relates to acts of domestic violence committed in the presence of children
sponsored.sum: Creates an automatic class E felony on the first offense for committing an act of domestic violence in the presence of children.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to engage in cooperative purchasing and authorizes intergovernmental agreements
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of environmental conservation to engage in cooperative purchasing; authorizes intergovernmental agreements between public agencies.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city school district of the city of Salamanca to establish a reserve fund for federal impact aid in the event such aid is reduced
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city school district of the city of Salamanca to establish a reserve fund for federal impact aid in the event such aid is reduced.

sponsored.t: Provides a $500,000 supplemental valuation impact grant to the West Valley central school district during the 2024-2025 school year
sponsored.sum: Provides a $500,000 supplemental valuation impact grant to the West Valley central school district during the 2024--2025 school year.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition and registration of mobility dealers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition and registration of mobility dealers.

sponsored.t: Permits certain judges, justices and support magistrates to carry a firearm, rifle, or shotgun in a sensitive location
sponsored.sum: Permits certain judges, justices and support magistrates to carry a firearm, rifle, or shotgun in a sensitive location.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of reckless endangerment of the public health for recklessly transmitting HIV/AIDS
sponsored.sum: Creates crimes of reckless endangerment of public health with respect to HIV/AIDS transmission; creates crime of filing false instrument with respect to HIV/AIDS; provides for HIV/AIDS testing for alleged sex offenders and public health offenders; provides for contagious disease testing for persons in the custody of the department of corrections; provides that if an incarcerated individual tests positive notice shall be given to all employees that will have contact with such incarcerated individual.

sponsored.t: Authorizes issuance of distinctive number plates to members of the Seneca Nation of Indians
sponsored.sum: Authorizes issuance of distinctive number plates to members of the Seneca Nation of Indians.

sponsored.t: Relates to extensions of order of protection
sponsored.sum: Allows family and criminal courts to extend orders of protection for up to two years beyond the expiration date of an issued order of protection if the court finds reason for an extension and places such reasoning on the record.

sponsored.t: Expands juvenile offender status to include certain sex offenses committed by persons 13, 14 or 15 years of age
sponsored.sum: Expands juvenile offender status to include rape in the first degree, criminal sexual act in the first degree, aggravated sexual abuse in the first degree, aggravated sexual abuse in the second degree and aggravated sexual abuse in the third degree if committed by persons thirteen, fourteen or fifteen years of age.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing for three forty-five day extensions of necessary and available emergency shelter for victims of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Allows for three forty-five day extensions of necessary and available emergency shelter for victims of domestic violence instead of the current two forty-five day extensions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as reforested lands certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus to discontinue as reforested lands certain reforested lands in the town of Perrysburg.

sponsored.t: Makes the crimes of menacing and stalking bail eligible
sponsored.sum: Makes the crimes of menacing and stalking bail eligible.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Franklynn Smith to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible list for appointment as a full-time police officer with the village of Perry
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Franklynn Smith, who has been continuously employed as a part-time police officer, to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible list for appointment as a full-time police officer with the village of Perry.

sponsored.t: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Eliminates sporting license fees for honorably discharged, disabled veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to granting a preference to New York State businesses in the state contract award process
sponsored.sum: Grants a preference to New York state businesses in the state contract award process where the New York state business' bid is within five percent of the winning bid.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Cattaraugus to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Cattaraugus to impose an additional mortgage recording tax until December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Cattaraugus to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Cattaraugus to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the city of Olean's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the city of Olean's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Allegany to impose an additional one and one-half percent sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the provisions authorizing the county of Allegany to impose an additional one and one-half percent sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.
